title: Lemaire 25AW Duck-Foot Toe Soft-Leather Slipper Loafers (imperfect/clearance — runs ~2 sizes small)
sizing: Get SIZE 43 (Hampus's true 41 + 2). These run ~2 sizes SMALL vs standard/Nike (seller: 'wear 42 → buy 44'). Hampus = true EU 41 / 26.5-27cm foot, so +2 = 43; 43 is in the available range (40-45). Soft full-grain buffalo cowhide has slight give and stretches a bit after ~2 days. ⚠️ HIGH-RISK / clearance item: discounted *because* the flat duck-foot last + narrow YB shoe-opening presses the top of the foot. Seller: do NOT buy if wide feet / high instep / chubby feet — you won't get them on. Length-wise the listing's own photo shows 'YB 40 ≈ bager 43' (they run very small), so 43 should match his foot length; if he wants extra length safety go 44, but it's a slip-on so too big = heel slip. Net: 43 is the call, but it's a gamble on the instep/opening.

size_chart.note: Runs ~2 sizes small vs standard. Sizes 40-45 (40-41 only for very small feet, run 1.5-2 small). Seller rule: your normal size + 2. Narrow duck-foot opening — instep is the limiting factor, not just length.
